chapterTitle: Chapter 13 Structure Determination: Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy
title: Problem 13-18

pages.text: PROBLEM 13-18 Propose structures for compounds that fit the following descriptions: (a) A hydrocarbon with seven lines in its 13C NMR spectrum (b) A six-carbon compound with only five lines in its 13C NMR spectrum (c) A four-carbon compound with three lines in its 13C NMR spectrum
